chapter: Trent's band: Texas, St. Louis and the road east
title: Port Stanley summer resort, pay trouble and the Lombardos
summary: The band spends a summer at a resort in Ontario and has trouble collecting; they first meet Guy Lombardo in London, Ontario.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: THEN YOU WENT UP TO (inaudible) FROM P--- DIDN'T YOU GET UP TO CANADA. PORT STANLEY.
ONTARIO. THAT WAS A SUMMER RESORT. MUST HAVE BEEN A FABULOUS PLACE.
It was a fabulous place, we stayed there the whole summer. It was beautiful.
GEE, THERE SHOULD BE SOME PICUTRES FROM THAT TOO YOU KNOW. I CAN'T BELIEVE THAT THERE WOULDN'T BE ANY PICTURES AND STUFF LIKE THAT.
I BET YOUR FIRST WIFE PROBABLY HAS ALL OF THAT STUFF.
I bet she's got a lot of it yeah.
YOU OUGHT TO GET A HOLD OF HER AND SEE IF SHE'S GOT ANY SNAP-SHOTS. HER HUSBAND PROBABLY THREW THEM ALL OUT.
Her husband is a little jealous from what I understand.
Her husband looks a little bit like me.
A LOT OF WOMEN DO THAT. MARRY A GUY THAT LOOKS JUST LIKE HER FORMER HUSBAND.
Yeah and he thought she was getting a little (inaudible).
SOMETHING HAPPENED ON THAT FIRST STANLEY JOB TOO, DIDN'T IT? DID YOU NOT GET PAID OR SOMETHING, DIDN'T SOMETHING HAPPEN UP THERE?

I really can't remember exactly what it was because we did have a little problem the last couple of weeks getting our money. It was a beautiful job though. THERE WAS A WHITE BAND UP THERE, FAIRLY WELL KNOWN, IT WASN'T GUY LOMBARDO.

We met Guy Lombardo just about the same time, Guy is from London, Ontario. He was from that same area. We played ballad music with Guy in London, Ontario, that's his home. That's where we first met him. That was before they came over to Cleveland. One of his brothers a saxophone player, not Carmen, the other guy plays tenor, he had a band in Toronto.
